description: Use this when someone asks about one listing whose id flatio_search_listings returned: its description, amenities, house rules, stay limits, availability, rating and price. With move_in and move_out it prices exactly those dates, broken into rent, service fee and deposit, and without them it gives the monthly rent. Not for finding listings. Give the guest each listing's url exactly as returned, with all its query parameters.

currency.description: Currency of every price in the result, e.g. "EUR". Send the currency of the search the id came from. Defaults to the currency of the response language's Flatio site.

language.description: Language of titles, texts and links, e.g. "en", "cs", "de", "es", "pt". Defaults to the language the client reports, else English.

move_in.description: Move-in date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2027-02-01". Send together with move_out.

move_out.description: Move-out date as YYYY-MM-DD, after move_in, e.g. "2027-08-01".

name: flatio_get_listing

total.description: Rent and service fee, without the refundable deposit.

title: Get one Flatio listing
